source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, Calls (rules 1.13, Skeleton 2.0): the nine gamma skills' speech actions in a fight. Every number is provisional (spec section 14).

rules.price_note: Rules 1.70 item 5535 (ruling layer section 2 items 2 and 3), PROVISIONAL: one table by the speaker's points in the Call's skill: its AP, how many times a turn each Call may be made, and from which row the reaction may pay (on your own turn, any Call, the reaction spent in place of the AP; off your turn, a helping Call only, once a round, for reaction_ap). The old free first Call at 10 and the reaction at 9 are gone.
rules.text: A Call is something you say to one unit that can hear you. It reaches farther with each point of its skill and never deals damage. Each Call is made once a turn, and costs less as its skill grows; at the top it may be made twice a turn and paid with your reaction. More points make it better: its effect grows in two steps. Each round a unit can be the target of one helping Call and one hindering Call. An enemy saves against 12 + your strength with the Call's skill (its points − 1). A Silenced unit can't Call. AP from a Call arrives this turn if the ally has not acted yet this round, and on their next turn if they have; nobody gains more than 3 AP in a turn or goes above 9 AP.

items.name: Order
items.text: Order an ally to do one thing right now. They do it on their reaction and it costs them no AP. You choose what they do, and it is never an attack.

steps.text: An ally reloads, stands up or picks up a pile right now. It uses their reaction and costs them no AP.
steps.short: An ally reloads, stands up or picks up a pile, free

steps.text: An ally reloads, stands up, picks up a pile or moves right now. The move goes as far as 1 AP walks them, to a tile you pick. It uses their reaction and costs them no AP.
steps.short: Or moves as far as {=.numbers.move} AP walks them

steps.text: An ally does two different things right now: reload, stand up, pick up a pile, or move as far as 1 AP walks them. Both use the one reaction and cost them no AP.
steps.short: {=.numbers.things} of those things at once

items.name: Rally
items.text: Give an ally AP. They get it this turn if they have not acted yet this round, and on their next turn if they have.

steps.text: An ally gains {=steps.0.numbers.ap} AP: this turn if they have not acted yet this round, on their next turn if they have.
steps.short: +{=.numbers.ap} AP to an ally

steps.text: An ally gains {=steps.1.numbers.ap} AP and loses {=steps.1.numbers.pressure} Pressure. The AP comes this turn if they have not acted yet this round, on their next turn if they have.
steps.short: +{=.numbers.ap} AP and {=.numbers.pressure} Pressure less

steps.text: An ally gains {=steps.2.numbers.ap} AP and loses {=steps.2.numbers.pressure} Pressure. The AP comes this turn if they have not acted yet this round, on their next turn if they have.
steps.short: +{=.numbers.ap} AP and {=.numbers.pressure} Pressure less

items.source: rules 1.74 item 6043 (re-stepped stronger: ruling layer section 2 item 4; re-stepped again by rules 1.87 item 7501, measured)

items.name: Brief
items.text: Make an ally's next actions cost less AP, or your own. On yourself it is made at the step below your own (at least the first). The discount lasts until the end of their next turn, and an action that costs no AP doesn't use it up. From Eloquence {=feeds.steps.0.from}, a Brief you give vents {=feeds.steps.0.value|abs} of your Flux.

steps.text: An ally's next action costs {=steps.0.numbers.first} AP less, and the one after it {=steps.0.numbers.second} AP less. This lasts until the end of their next turn.
steps.short: Next action {=.numbers.first} AP less, the one after {=.numbers.second} less

steps.text: An ally's next two actions cost {=steps.1.numbers.first} AP less each. This lasts until the end of their next turn.
steps.short: Their next two actions cost {=.numbers.first} AP less each

steps.text: An ally's next action costs {=steps.2.numbers.first} AP less, and the one after it {=steps.2.numbers.second} AP less. This lasts until the end of their next turn.
steps.short: Next action {=.numbers.first} AP less, the one after {=.numbers.second} less

items.name: Name It
items.text: Tell an ally, or yourself, what they are facing, so it can't get into their head. They get a bonus on all their saves until the start of your next turn.

steps.text: You or an ally gets +{=steps.0.numbers.saves} on all saves until the start of your next turn.
steps.short: +{=.numbers.saves} on all saves

steps.text: You or an ally gets +{=steps.1.numbers.saves} on all saves until the start of your next turn, and rolls a new save right now against one condition they have.
steps.short: +{=.numbers.saves} on all saves and a new save against one condition

steps.text: You or an ally gets +{=steps.2.numbers.saves} on all saves until the start of your next turn, rolls a new save right now against one condition they have, and stops being Shaken and Afraid.
steps.short: +{=.numbers.saves} on all saves, a new save, and Shaken and Afraid end

items.name: Cue
items.text: Give an ally one more reaction. They must use it before the start of your next turn.

steps.text: An ally gets one more reaction, to use before the start of your next turn.
steps.short: An ally gets one more reaction

steps.text: An ally gets one more reaction, to use before the start of your next turn. Or name a free tile next to them: they step there at once instead, for no AP and without provoking an opportunity attack.
steps.short: Or they step at once to a tile you name

steps.text: An ally gets one more reaction, to use before the start of your next turn, or steps at once to a free tile you name next to them (no AP, no opportunity attack). If you Call on your own turn and they have not acted yet this round, they also take their turn straight after yours.
steps.short: And if they have not acted yet, they go straight after you

items.name: Spot
items.text: Point out an enemy to your allies. There is no save. The mark lasts until the start of your next turn and is used up when an ally attacks that enemy; you can't use it yourself.

steps.text: The next ally to attack this enemy ignores its cover. There is no save, and you can't use the mark yourself. It lasts until the start of your next turn.
steps.short: The next ally to attack it ignores its cover

steps.text: The next ally to attack this enemy ignores its cover and can target it even if it is Hidden. You can Spot a Hidden enemy if you can see its tile. There is no save, and you can't use the mark yourself. It lasts until the start of your next turn.
steps.short: And can attack it even while it is Hidden

steps.text: The next two allies to attack this enemy ignore its cover, get +{=steps.2.numbers.hit} to hit and can target it even if it is Hidden. You can Spot a Hidden enemy if you can see its tile. There is no save, and you can't use the mark yourself. It lasts until the start of your next turn.
steps.short: The next {=.numbers.allies} allies, with +{=.numbers.hit} to hit

items.name: Warn

feeds.source: rules 1.98 item 8352 (body.json sensory points 2 and 6): a Warn that lands raises the speaker's plates, up to its Reach

items.text: Warn an ally, or yourself, about the next weapon attack on them. On yourself it is made at the step below your own (at least the first). From Sensory {=feeds.steps.0.from}, a Warn that lands (the warned one steps) gives you {=feeds.steps.0.value} Guard plate, {=feeds.steps.1.value} from Sensory {=feeds.steps.1.from}, up to your Reach. Just before it is rolled they step out of the way, for no AP and without provoking an opportunity attack: to a tile you named, or else to the nearest tile that gets them clear. An attack that can no longer reach them is wasted. The warning lasts until the start of your next turn.

steps.text: Just before the next weapon attack on an ally is rolled, they step 1 tile out of the way for no AP: to a tile you named, or else to the nearest tile that gets them clear. An attack that can no longer reach them is wasted. It lasts until the start of your next turn.
steps.short: They step {=.numbers.tiles} tile out of the attack's way

steps.text: Just before the next weapon attack on an ally is rolled, they step up to {=steps.1.numbers.tiles} tiles out of the way for no AP: to a tile you named, or else to the nearest tile that gets them clear. An attack that can no longer reach them is wasted. It lasts until the start of your next turn.
steps.short: Up to {=.numbers.tiles} tiles out of the way

steps.text: Just before the next weapon attack on an ally is rolled, they step up to {=steps.2.numbers.tiles} tiles out of the way for no AP: to a tile you named, or else to the nearest tile that gets them clear. That attack is at {=steps.2.numbers.hit} to hit, and it is wasted if it can no longer reach them. It lasts until the start of your next turn.
steps.short: Up to {=.numbers.tiles} tiles, and the attack is at {=.numbers.hit} to hit

items.name: Threaten
items.text: Frighten an enemy. It makes a Heart save against 12 + your strength with Intimidation. If it fails, it is Shaken for 3 rounds and loses AP on its next turn.

steps.text: The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Shaken for 3 rounds and loses {=steps.0.numbers.ap_loss} AP on its next turn.
steps.short: If it fails its save: Shaken and {=.numbers.ap_loss} AP less

steps.text: The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Shaken for 3 rounds, loses {=steps.1.numbers.ap_loss} AP on its next turn and can't move toward you on that turn.
steps.short: And it can't move toward you on its turn

steps.text: The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Shaken for 3 rounds, loses {=steps.2.numbers.ap_loss} AP on its next turn and can't move toward you on that turn.
steps.short: {=.numbers.ap_loss} AP less, and it can't move toward you

items.name: Taunt
items.text: Goad an enemy. It makes a Heart save against 12 + your strength with Insinuation. If it fails, it is Taunted for 1 round: its next attack must be aimed at you, if it can see you.

steps.text: The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Taunted for 1 round: its next attack must be aimed at you, if it can see you.
steps.short: If it fails its save, its next attack must be at you

steps.text: The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Taunted for 1 round: its next attack must be aimed at you, if it can see you, and that attack costs it {=steps.1.numbers.attack_ap} AP more.
steps.short: And that attack costs it {=.numbers.attack_ap} AP more

steps.text: The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Taunted for 1 round: its next attack must be aimed at you, if it can see you, and that attack costs it {=steps.2.numbers.attack_ap} AP more.
steps.short: That attack costs it {=.numbers.attack_ap} AP more
